name: send
description: Send text to one destination. For a correspondent, the returned reference confirms acceptance for delivery. A focus message enters its recipient's queue and can wake that focus. For a feed, the returned sequence identifies the stored message.

channel_id.description: Copy the complete address of a correspondent, focus, or feed from current.channels or a tool result.

name: create_feed
description: Create a shared feed whose messages stay available to readers across restarts. Any focus can publish using the returned channel_id with send. Give the returned feed_id to a reader. An activity can run "$IVENNA" feed read --help for usage.

description.description: Describe what readers can expect to find in the feed.

name: close_feed
description: Close a feed to new messages while keeping published messages available to readers. The result says whether this call closed the feed.

feed_id.description: Copy the complete feed ID from current.channels.feeds or the create_feed result.

name: open_focus
description: Open an activity to pursue a task while the core continues. The activity can run host commands and report to the core. Use the returned channel_id to reach it with send.

name: schedule_attention
description: Leave yourself something to return to later by scheduling a wakeup for the core. The wakeup survives restart.

name: subscribe
description: Register this focus to receive reports from a listener you set up. Give that listener the returned subscription_id. Reports can wake this focus. An activity can run "$IVENNA" subscription --help to find reporting commands.

listener.description: Describe what the listener watches and when it reports.

name: withdraw_subscription
description: Close any focus's subscription to new reports. Reports already accepted still reach the subscribing focus. Stop the listener separately if needed.
